edge.scene: Visual upgrade of existing model administration
edge.trigger: An operator enters the actual GLB upload workflow through admin navigation or the /admin/models breadcrumb.
edge.expect: Preserve /models to /new redirect, upload/check/READY/publish-confirmation rules and existing preview functions; add no model-list business. Actual HTTP/GLB/GIF and density evidence at three viewports proves all controls remain usable in the unique locked style.

modules.M1: Owns brand/public experience, media, company facts and the unique shared visual token/component source.
modules.M2: Owns public product cards, existing GLB viewing interactions, accessible controls and model event producers.
modules.M3: Owns admin access/accounts and the admin shell; consumes M1 visuals and migrates existing admin interfaces without changing business APIs.
modules.M4: Owns first-party human consultation, inbox/replies and its notification jobs, not legacy mail feature activation.
modules.M5: Owns consent, event ingestion, aggregation, timezone, retention policy and job foundation.
modules.M6: Owns real business/operations dashboard queries, source status and role restrictions.
modules.M7: Owns final actual integration and delivery evidence; creates no prerequisite foundation.
